Joins 2026 code violation counts per tract with CDC adult high blood pressure prevalence, computes violations per 1,000 residents, and returns the paired tract set with the overall correlation and paired tract count, ranked by violation rate descending.
sql:
WITH violations AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS code_violations_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261027_41b47d' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
),
health AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS bphigh_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_41b47d_m2_cdc
),
paired AS (
  SELECT t.name AS tract_name,
         COALESCE(v.code_violations_count, 0) AS code_violations_count,
         h.totalpopulation,
         COALESCE(v.code_violations_count, 0) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(h.totalpopulation, 0) AS code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,
         h.bphigh_prevalence,
         t.geoid
  FROM fw_pg.tracts t
  LEFT JOIN violations v ON v.geoid = t.geoid
  LEFT JOIN health h ON h.geoid = t.geoid
  WHERE h.bphigh_prevalence IS NOT NULL AND h.totalpopulation > 0
)
SELECT tract_name,
       code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,
       code_violations_count,
       totalpopulation,
       bphigh_prevalence,
       CORR(code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpopulation, bphigh_prevalence) OVER () AS rate_prevalence_correlation,
       COUNT(*) OVER () AS paired_tracts,
       geoid
FROM paired
ORDER BY code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpopulation DESC NULLS LAST, tract_name ASC
LIMIT 200

  SELECT geoid, n AS code_violations_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261027_41b47d' AND source = 'm1_city' AND grp = 'all'
),
health AS (
  SELECT tractfips AS geoid,
         CAST(totalpopulation AS DOUBLE) AS totalpopulation,
         CAST(bphigh_crudeprev AS DOUBLE) AS bphigh_prevalence
  FROM session.fw_41b47d_m2_cdc
),
paired AS (
  SELECT t.name AS tract_name,
         COALESCE(v.code_violations_count, 0) AS code_violations_count,
         h.totalpopulation,
         COALESCE(v.code_violations_count, 0) * 1000.0 / NULLIF(h.totalpopulation, 0) AS code_violations_count_per_1000_totalpopulation,
         h.bphigh_prevalence,
         t.geoid

  LEFT JOIN violations v ON v.geoid = t.geoid
